Locators are the page numbers printed in the running header ("N of 25"), which equal PDF page numbers. Review by a TOMRA author: qualitative on energy and cost. It prints NO energy use (kWh/t), no sorter capex/opex and no emission figures, so separator_ore-sorting gets only description, state of development and per-sorter design feed capacity (t/h) for the five lighthouse plants in Table 4 (Mittersill, Karowe, Umm Wu'al, San Rafael, Renard - Renard is in Canada). Mass rejection, grades and recoveries are in the description notes; plant-level capex ratio and one whole-plant cost (USD 560 million Umm Wu'al, no price year) are in other-values. The value of sorting for the database (fewer tonnes ground) would need comminution energy per t, which this source does not give.
